caseName: Oregon Short Line & Utah Northern Railway Co. v. Mullan
caseNameFull: Oregon Short Line and Utah Northern Railway Company v. Mullan
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oregon.
attorneys: Mr. John M. Thurston for plaintiff in error. Mr. John F. Dillon was on his brief., Mr. Alfred S. Bennett for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Shiras
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Shiras

: The facts of this ease are similar to those of the case of The Oregon Short Line and Northern Railway Company v. Jane Skottowe, just decided, and for the reasons there given the judgment of the Supreme Court of Oregon is

Affirmed.
